item.title: [Message Center] MC1556098 Microsoft Teams Mobile: Introducing shared call history in the Queues app
item.description:
Microsoft Teams mobile Queues app now offers shared call history for authorized representatives, showing missed, answered, outgoing, and voicemail calls. Rolling out worldwide in December 2026, it helps teams manage calls efficiently with status updates and filtering, extending desktop features to mobile without new admin actions.

Microsoft Teams · Stay Informed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1556096 Microsoft Teams: Audio announcement for Recording and Transcription
item.description:
Microsoft Teams now supports an optional audio announcement when recording or transcription starts, configurable via Meeting and Calling Policies. Rolling out from May 2026 to January 2027 worldwide. No admin action required; default is off. Compliance recording is not supported with this feature.

Microsoft Teams · Stay Informed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1556093 Microsoft 365 Copilot: Learning Agent introduces personalized upskilling notifications in Teams
item.description:
Microsoft 365 Copilot Learning Agent will deliver personalized upskilling notifications in Teams based on users' roles and usage. Rolling out from mid-November 2026, it helps users access relevant training within Teams, enhancing AI fluency and confidence. Admins can manage notifications via Viva Learning settings.

Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365) · Stay Informed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1556088 Microsoft Teams: End of support for iOS 17 and iPadOS 17
item.description:
Microsoft Teams will end support for iOS 17 and iPadOS 17 starting mid-December 2026, requiring iOS/iPadOS 18 or later for new releases. Existing versions will keep working without support. Organizations should notify users, encourage OS upgrades, update policies, and revise support documentation accordingly.

Microsoft Teams · Plan for Change · act by 2027-01-02

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552394 Microsoft Viva Engage: Retirement of Teams town hall event creation
item.description:
Starting December 7, 2026, users cannot create Teams town hall events from Viva Engage; previously scheduled events will continue. Organizers must use the new Events experience in Viva Engage or Microsoft Teams. Organizations should inform teams and update documentation accordingly before this date.

Microsoft Viva · planForChange · act by 2026-12-07

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552392 Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording indicator for call queue calls on Mobile
item.description:
Microsoft Teams on Mobile will show a clear banner indicating automatic, uninterruptible recording and transcription of call queue calls by the organization. This update, rolling out worldwide in December 2026, aligns mobile with desktop and requires no admin action, though informing calling reps is recommended.

Microsoft Teams · stayInformed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552391 Microsoft Teams: Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile
item.description:
Microsoft Teams is introducing Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile, allowing reps and supervisors to ask questions about recorded calls for quick insights. Rolling out worldwide from late November to mid-December 2026, it requires Teams Premium and Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses, with no admin action needed before rollout.

Microsoft Teams · stayInformed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1552390 Microsoft Teams: Manage call groups on Mobile
item.description:
Microsoft Teams will allow users to create and manage call groups directly on Mobile, enabling call forwarding and ring settings without desktop access. This feature, rolling out worldwide in December 2026, requires a Teams Phone license and enabled calling policy, with no admin action needed before rollout.

Microsoft Teams · stayInformed

item.title: [Message Center] MC1546409 Microsoft Teams: Retirement of off-network invitations to Teams Free
item.description:
Microsoft Teams will retire off-network invitations for Teams Free accounts starting December 2026. Users can no longer invite external people via email or chat links to create Teams Free accounts. Existing Teams Free collaboration and federation remain unchanged. No admin action is needed, but user guidance should be updated.

Microsoft Teams · planForChange

item.description:

item.title: [New] Teams retires off-network email and link invitations that onboard outsiders to Teams Free in December; federation with existing Teams Free users stays
item.description:

Teams · Update helpdesk guidance before 6 December; review the external-access policy for Teams Free (consumer) accounts while the topic is open.
